scope.title: Xây dựng và đánh giá hệ thống phát hiện lời phàn nàn trong đánh giá sản phẩm tiếng Việt
scope.primary_question: Effect of the Underthesea versus pinned VnCoreNLP/RDR word-segmentation pipeline on PhoBERT under the same partial-fine-tuning schedule
scope.proposed_runtime: Private Kaggle CUDA GPU; no CPU training fallback

dataset.fit_policy: Learned transforms and model fitting use retained train only; validation selects checkpoints/configuration; historical test used only for terminal descriptive evaluation

decision.reason: UIT-ViOCD has task-matched Vietnamese complaint/non-complaint review labels, rather than proxy sentiment or star labels. Prior use is not a reason by itself to retain it.
decision.reselection_rule: Change before freeze if verified task-fit, provenance, label quality and usable rights justify another source; regenerate split/data manifest and all configurations rather than combine incompatible labels
decision.historical_data_role: If retained, pinned old cohort remains historical; it is not a newly independent corpus

model.classification_head: AutoModelForSequenceClassification(num_labels=2), seeded separately per fit; no custom dropout override
model.initialization: Reload pinned pretrained base for every configuration/seed; never initialize from a historical fine-tuned checkpoint

normalization: collapse whitespace with str.split then single-space join
preprocessing.shared_boundary: raw review -> shared normalization -> selected segmenter -> single-space joined review text -> same pinned PhoBERT tokenizer

rdr.sentence_join: Preserve sentence order, join returned segmented sentences with one ASCII space; no stopword removal or punctuation stripping
rdr.java_minimum: 1.8+ according to upstream; target runtime version must be logged
rdr.local_java_smoke: PASS; Windows Java21 synthetic sentence only
rdr.local_python_wrapper_smoke: PASS; isolated Windows target py_vncorenlp0.1.4 plus pyjnius1.9.0, synthetic sentence only

preprocessing.case_policy_reason: Hold historical lowercasing fixed; experiment is not a full match to pretraining preprocessing
preprocessing.collision_rule: Before fitting, audit exact normalized, segmenter-output and truncated-token-ID duplicates across splits without using heldout labels to choose rules. Halt on a cross-split collision; investigate via a documented amendment before any training, never silently drop rows or change test population

full_corpus_segmentation_audit.scope: Fresh5247 retained reviews, Underthesea and pinned RDR, localCPU/Java; no training or GPU inference

tokenizer_input_audit.scope: Local tokenization only, pinned config/vocab/BPE; no model weights or training
tokenizer_input_audit.known_limit_policy: Preserve cohort and per-review weighting; intra-train duplicate after truncation is a documented representation limit, not cross-split leakage. Do not alter labels/drop rows/change max_length based on score. Do not infer identical duplicate row identities across arms unless checked

optimizer.name: torch.optim.AdamW
optimizer.note: Betas/eps/amsgrad inherit PyTorch defaults; implementation must assert actual values

training.frozen_modules_mode: Freeze embeddings and first ten encoder layers; force frozen modules eval() each epoch; last two layers/classifier train()
training.seed_policy: transformers.set_seed(seed) before fresh model/head and loader initialization for every fit; same seed paired across P0/P1
training.failure_policy: Keep failed attempt metadata; inspect before retry. Retry same locked configuration for technical failure only, not because validation/test score is disappointing

baseline.fit_scope: Pipeline fit on retained train only; no A/B/C re-selection in this fixed S0 protocol
baseline.seed_mean_comparison_note: S0 is one fixed deterministic classical fit; P0/P1 mean is across three stochastic fits on the same examples, not an ensemble or three times more test samples

selection.epoch_rule: For each P0/P1 seed, choose greatest validation Macro-F1 among epochs1..3; strict greater-than update retains earliest epoch on an exact tie
selection.configuration_rule: Compare S0 validation Macro-F1 with the arithmetic mean of the three selected-checkpoint validation Macro-F1 scores for P0/P1; choose maximum
selection.tie_interpretation: Numerical tie policy only; does not establish statistical equivalence or operational non-inferiority
selection.test_usage: No test scores/predictions in the development training loop. Save all validation outcomes and selected configuration before a separate terminal test evaluation of all declared configurations. Historical test remains post-hoc
selection.demo_rule: Primary demo uses validation-selected family. If PhoBERT selected, use seed42 predeclared checkpoint and identify its own score separately from three-seed mean. Research demo may expose other models with explicit labels

evaluation.primary: Clean historical test P1-minus-P0 difference in mean per-seed Macro-F1, interpreted descriptively alongside validation and exposure history
secondary: observed training time and peak VRAM

bootstrap.method: paired label-stratified review resampling with same sampled rows for every configuration/seed
bootstrap.estimand: difference of mean per-seed Macro-F1 for P1/P0, fixed fitted seeds
bootstrap.scope_limit: Conditional on these fitted models and historical fixed sample; no model-selection, future-seed or independent-domain guarantee

error_examples.allocation: largest-remainder proportional allocation over domains within each true-label/transition, domain-name ascending tie break
error_examples.interpretation: Illustrative diagnosis, not representative population error-frequency estimation

evaluation.hypothesis_policy: One primary contrast; remaining comparisons descriptive. CI including zero supports neither established superiority nor equivalence

environment.torch_cuda_policy: Inspect and record Kaggle CUDA image in preflight; no silent container/library substitution. If incompatible with locked training APIs, amend protocol before fitting
unverified: pyjnius/wrapper compatibility on target Kaggle Python

before_fit: protocol freeze receipt and source SHA
development: validation predictions keyed by split/source-row ID
terminal_evaluation: per-seed test predictions keyed by split/source-row ID
artifacts.privacy: Keep raw corpus, row-level outputs, checkpoints and whole execution logs private; public code only within prior user authorization and source conditions
artifacts.screenshots: Capture actual target runtime and completed run only after they exist; bind evidence image to run ID/source/version

readiness_blockers: New separated development/terminal-evaluation trainer has not been implemented or tested
Kaggle Python wrapper/import/resource smoke not yet executed

preparation_acceptance.interpretation: Preparation only; not permission to treat an unimplemented trainer or current Kaggle GPU as verified
